# G2

7 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 1 standard (1 credit), 5 advanced (5), 1 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

G2 software marketplace: product pages by slug or URL, product reviews, category product listings, vendor (seller) profiles with their catalog, and URL indexes for both categories and products. The B2B counterpart to Trustpilot's consumer reputation data.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/g2/categories - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the full G2 category taxonomy as URL + slug rows. Feed a slug into GET /v1/g2/category to list the products in that category. Static reference data, so it is 1 credit and heavily cached.

**Use when** Use it first to find a category slug, then pass that slug to the category endpoint to list products.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - The upstream returns the complete category URL dump in one call (2,227 links, live-verified 2026-09-01) and exposes no page parameter.

**Response** `Analytics` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ url, id }` (inferred from a sample): {url string, id string}.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/g2/categories" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/g2/category - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns one page of G2 products in a software category, 15 per page: name, slug, rating, review count, seller, and logo. Sort by G2 score, popularity, or satisfaction. Get a category slug from GET /v1/g2/categories.

**Use when** you want to walk a G2 category and discover product slugs. Get the category slug from the categories endpoint first.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · page size not measured · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `category` (required) - G2 category slug or full category URL, for example marketing-automation or https://www.g2.com/categories/marketing-automation. · e.g. `marketing-automation`
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `sort` (optional, enum: g2-score | popularity | satisfaction) - Product order in the category. Default g2-score.

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.reviews_count` |  |
| `product.seller` |  |

+1 more (types in the full schema): `product.rating` {average}. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/g2/category" \
  --data-urlencode "category=marketing-automation" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/g2/product - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns one G2 software product: name, description, star rating, review count, categories, seller, pricing plans, feature list, alternatives, comparisons, and media. Pass the G2 slug (postman) or the full G2 product URL. Contact enrichment of the product's own website is off by default; set website_contacts_crawl_mode to homepage or deep to include it. For written reviews call GET /v1/g2/reviews with the same id.

**Use when** you have a G2 slug or product URL and need the full product page, including rating and pricing, before paging reviews.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - G2 product slug or full G2 product URL. Slug example: postman. URL example: https://www.g2.com/products/postman/reviews. · e.g. `postman`
- `url` (optional, string) - G2 product slug or full G2 product URL. Slug example: postman. URL example: https://www.g2.com/products/postman/reviews.
- `website_contacts_crawl_mode` (optional, enum: off | homepage | deep) - How far to crawl the product website for emails, phones, and social profiles. Default off. homepage scans the homepage only. deep also crawls contact, about, careers, and blog pages.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.description` |  |

+4 more (types in the full schema): `product` {reviews_count, seller}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Also in the sample: `product.price` {current null, original null, currency null}; `product` {availability null}; `product.ext` {requested_id string}; `product.ext.g2` {product_uuid string}; `product.ext.g2.categories[]` {name string, link string}; `product.ext.g2.comparisons[]` {link string, name string, logo string, rating number, reviews number}; `product.ext.g2.alternatives[]` {name string, link string} (+37 more).

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/g2/product" \
  --data-urlencode "id=postman" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/g2/product-index - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns G2 product review-page URLs, 100 per page, each with the product slug as id. Use a slug with GET /v1/g2/product or GET /v1/g2/reviews. The upstream sends the full catalogue in one call; this endpoint pages it so the response stays small. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.

**Use when** you want to walk the G2 product catalogue and collect slugs for the product and reviews endpoints.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 100/page · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/100) x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.

**Response** `Analytics` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ url, id }` (inferred from a sample): {url string, id string}.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/g2/product-index" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/g2/reviews - 5-9 credits (request-shaped)

Returns written G2 reviews for a software product, 10 per page. Filter by star rating, company segment, industry, reviewer role, region, or keyword, and sort by G2 relevance, recency, helpfulness, or rating. G2 caps each filter combination at 10 pages; use the returned cursor until has_more is false. Get the product slug from GET /v1/g2/product.

**Use when** you want the review text itself. For rating and review count only, one call to the product endpoint is cheaper than paging reviews.
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.
**Paging** page (native `page`) · page size not measured · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - G2 product slug or full G2 product URL. Slug example: postman. URL example: https://www.g2.com/products/postman/reviews. · e.g. `postman`
- `url` (optional, string) - G2 product slug or full G2 product URL. Slug example: postman. URL example: https://www.g2.com/products/postman/reviews.
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `industry` (optional, string) - Comma-separated G2 industry ids. Discover valid ids from a first unfiltered call.
- `keywords` (optional, string) - Free-text search inside review bodies.
- `region` (optional, string) - Comma-separated reviewer regions: North America, Europe, Asia, Latin America, Middle East, Africa, ANZ.
- `role` (optional, string) - Comma-separated reviewer roles, for example Administrator, User, Consultant.
- `segment` (optional, enum: small-business | mid-market | enterprise) - Reviewer company size: small-business (50 or fewer), mid-market (51-1000), enterprise (more than 1000).
- `sort` (optional, enum: default | most-recent | most-helpful | highest-rated | lowest-rated) - Review order. Default is G2 relevance.
- `stars` (optional, string) - Comma-separated star ratings, for example 4,5.
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `computed.labels_evidence` | When 1, every labelled row also carries… (with `label_evidence=1`) |
| `computed.labels.incentivized` | incentivized: does the reviewer say they got the product… (with `label=incentivized`) |
| `computed.labels.injection` | injection flags text that addresses an AI system and tries… (with `label=injection`) |

+7 more (types in the full schema): `computed.labels` {issue, reports, sentiment}; `review` {title, url}; `review.author` {name}; `review.rating` {value}. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/g2/reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "id=postman" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/g2/seller - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns one G2 seller: name, description, aggregate rating, review count, headquarters, year founded, website, and a page of the product portfolio. Product and review teasers paginate independently via products_page and reviews_page. For the full product list without the profile chrome, call GET /v1/g2/seller/products.

**Use when** you have a seller slug and need the vendor page. For the product list alone, call seller/products.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - G2 seller slug or full G2 seller URL. Slug example: hubspot. URL example: https://www.g2.com/sellers/hubspot. · e.g. `hubspot`
- `url` (optional, string) - G2 seller slug or full G2 seller URL. Slug example: hubspot. URL example: https://www.g2.com/sellers/hubspot.
- `handle` (optional, string) - G2 seller slug or full G2 seller URL. Slug example: hubspot. URL example: https://www.g2.com/sellers/hubspot.
- `products_page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page of the seller product portfolio, 9 products per page.
- `reviews_page` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Page of cross-product review teasers, 3 per page, capped at 10.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`, `handle`.

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |
| `author.external_url` | Bio link / external website URL when surfaced by the… |

+5 more (types in the full schema): `author` {posts_count}; `computed` {content_category, engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/g2/seller" \
  --data-urlencode "id=hubspot" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/g2/seller/products - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns one page of a G2 seller's product portfolio, 9 per page: name, slug, rating, review count, and description. Use GET /v1/g2/seller when you also need the seller profile.

**Use when** you want to walk a seller's full catalogue. Use the seller endpoint when you also need the vendor profile.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · page size not measured · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - G2 seller slug or full G2 seller URL. Slug example: hubspot. URL example: https://www.g2.com/sellers/hubspot. · e.g. `google`
- `url` (optional, string) - G2 seller slug or full G2 seller URL. Slug example: hubspot. URL example: https://www.g2.com/sellers/hubspot.
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.reviews_count` |  |
| `product.seller` |  |

+1 more (types in the full schema): `product.rating` {average}. Also in the sample: `product` {description null, brand null, availability null}; `product.price` {current null, original null, currency null}; `product.rating` {count null}. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/g2/seller/products" \
  --data-urlencode "id=google" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
